findings.problem: The round-3 L22a Minor is still open in the part this lesson keeps. This gauge and absolute pressure paragraph has six sentences, over the limit of one to three short sentences. Other kept paragraphs also run over: the units paragraph (five), the Archimedes' principle paragraph (five), the paragraph on what the buoyant force formula uses (five) and the average density paragraph (five). The text is new in this rewrite, so the Minor must be fixed. Note, not a finding: the paragraph after the depth formula says the formula 'has the fluid's density, $g$, and the depth' and the shortcut and Trap #4 repeat that list without the surface pressure $P_0$. This is right for comparing open containers, which is every case the lesson works, but it would mislead for a sealed tank with gas above the liquid at a different pressure. A fixer may add the same-surface-pressure condition. The split itself is clean: no text points to continuity, Bernoulli, Examples #8 and #9, or the moved traps, and 'see Example #7' still points to the apparent weight example here.
